facts.value: Once your admission deferment is approved, your ASU scholarships will be automatically deferred — except if your deferment is for personal or financial reasons.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: In cases of personal or financial reasons for deferment, you must submit a scholarship deferment form to Financial Aid and Scholarship Services for review.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: If any scholarships or financial aid have already been disbursed, you must return those funds.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Private scholarships cannot be deferred by ASU.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: You must contact your scholarship sponsor directly to request a deferment.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: The sponsor will decide whether to approve the deferment.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA
